brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION:
Use case: ads-marketing / illustration-story.
Create exactly one finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, wide 16:9, ideally 1920x1080 and at least 1000px wide. It is a NEW image for バスケまとめ, based on the fixed 2026-11-22 pregame registered-player best-five article.
Visual references already viewed in conversation: black-and-lime approved B-culver-black-lime-v3.png is STYLE ONLY; the official B.LEAGUE portrait of Tomohiro Ishii is LIKENESS ONLY. Do not copy any text, player identity, scores, logos, or pose from the style reference; do not paste any official photo.

Style: sophisticated bold hand-drawn sports editorial ink-and-dry-brush illustration, charcoal black #151A18 background, acid lime #CCF43B brush accents, warm ivory type and illustrated skin, one orange basketball accent. Obviously an illustration, never photographic. Few elements, exceptional Japanese typographic clarity, strong negative space.
Subject: exactly one REAL player, 石井智大 / Tomohiro Ishii. He was randomly chosen from named players in the fixed source, NOT identified as the article's star. Match the official portrait just viewed: Japanese adult man, athletic broad shoulders, clean-shaven face, somewhat broad oval face tapering to a soft jaw, short softly waved brown hair with darker roots and a clear middle part, curtain-like front locks to the temples, exposed center forehead, relatively straight dark eyebrows, narrow dark almond eyes, medium straight nose, recognisable mouth and cheek contours. Do not invent a different person's face. Express focused determination while keeping these identity features.
Composition: athlete occupies the LEFT 43% of the canvas, twisting in a low forward dribble in three-quarter view, face clearly visible, knees bent, one hand controlling the single ball at hip/upper-thigh level, other arm balancing naturally. Draw two anatomically coherent arms and hands; all fingers plausible. Plain ivory and charcoal basketball uniform with absolutely NO names, numbers, team emblems, league marks or sponsor lettering. Frame from head through knees with deliberate clean lower crop; entire head, both hands and ball safely inside canvas. A sweeping lime dry-brush curve behind the athlete suggests motion. This is a generic imagined basketball action, NOT a depiction/reconstruction of any actual game, no opponent, no hoop, no arena signage.
Type on the RIGHT 53%, balanced and clear; bold heavy Japanese Gothic with occasional brush emphasis. Headline huge, and emphasize ベスト5 in lime. Leave generous padding around all text and a clearly readable full-width footer. No text touches athlete.
Text, verbatim, and ONLY the following text:
Small top line: "11/22  B.ONE・B.NEXT"
Small pregame descriptor: "試合前｜今季平均EFF"
Large headline split over two lines:
"登録選手の"
"ベスト5"
Supporting scope line: "対象試合の登録選手から"
Supporting scope line: "リーグ別に選出"

Do not claim game outcomes, performance on this day, confirmed appearance, best-player honors for the illustrated person, combined inter-league ranking, or reproduce scores/stats. Never print the athlete's name. All text must be spelled exactly as above with no invented characters or extra copy. The AI label and イメージ must be visible inside safe margins. Do not render logos, photo fragments, watermark, signature, jersey number or personal name.

ONE PERMITTED CORRECTION:
Edit the FIRST attached image, the finished black/lime Japanese basketball thumbnail. The SECOND attached image is an official portrait of the real player Tomohiro Ishii and is LIKENESS REFERENCE ONLY, never paste it or reproduce its jersey.
Make exactly one targeted correction: improve the drawn athlete's head and face resemblance to Ishii in the second image, preserving the ink illustration medium and focused game-face expression. The current face is too gaunt and angular and the hair too large/high. Use his broader, softer oval cheek and jaw contours, smoother clean-shaven chin, straighter relatively narrow dark brows, narrower eyes, and actual nose and mouth proportions from the official portrait. Reduce the high hair volume to his actual compact brown softly-wavy center-parted curtain hairstyle, sides falling near the temples, with visible forehead and darker roots. Keep the entire head safely inside the canvas.
Keep ALL remaining parts of the first image exactly unchanged: composition, body pose, two natural hands, single basketball, logo-free and number-free ivory jersey, charcoal/lime palette, hand-painted brush texture, every Japanese letter and number, exact wording, headline hierarchy, caution bar, and AI footer. No official photo fragment, no photorealism, no names, no new text, no logos.
All nine text lines remain exactly: "11/22  B.ONE・B.NEXT", "試合前｜今季平均EFF", "登録選手の", "ベスト5", "対象試合の登録選手から", "リーグ別に選出", "出場確定ではありません", "イラスト（AI生成）", "イメージ". Output exactly one PNG in the same wide approximately 16:9 dimensions at least 1000px wide.
